items.title: Dave Bennett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 16, 2025
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe... Hi, Dave. [INTERVIEWEE] How are you doing, Monk? Good to see you.

ctx.x: Dave was interviewed via Zoom on April 16, 2025 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive. I am very pleased to have Dave Bennett with me this morning, not exactly musicians’ hours. Hi, Dave.
How are you doing, Monk? Good to see you.
